project.name: host/netplan-bridge-api
project.description: The netplan BRIDGE port — the host-owned network blueprint contract. Carries ClusterNetworkBlueprint and its value-type collaborators (Cidr, MacAddress); the OSGi netplan bundle depends on it to derive and synthesise, the host (and the nix-darwin-home blueprint feed) consumes it. NetplanSynthesisService is CLI-facing, not a bridge port — it stays on the netplan impl side.
